title: October Week 3
subtitle: The lead article of this issue of The FAPS Chronicles (October Week 3, 2026), titled "Preparations All the Way," highlights the campus-wide excitement and dedicated efforts underway for the upcoming school production of The Girl with the Golden Hair. Showcasing unity across the school community, student captains, prefects, teachers, and the choir are investing long hours into rehearsals alongside a versatile dance ensemble combining styles from Bharatnatyam and Bhangra to Hip Hop and Ballet. Backed by teacher vocalists, tech crew coordination, and special music curated by Vice Principal Mr. Craig William Temple, the ambitious production serves as a centerpiece celebrating school pride, cross-grade camaraderie, and artistic collaboration.

articles.content: This edition of The FAPS Chronicles delivers comprehensive coverage of our solemn Founder’s Day assembly alongside preparations for the inaugural Quad-FAPS athletic meet. We celebrate our milestone Under-16 triumph in the Cottonian Shield, ending a thirteen-year drought, while tracking global sports from Asian Games cricket gold to upcoming international football friendlies. Tech-minded scholars can dive into OpenAI’s new Socratic “Study Mode” alongside groundbreaking astrophysics discoveries tracing radio signals from distant exoplanets. For practical life skills, we break down essential financial literacy modules from Zerodha Varsity tailored specifically for teens. Our candid Students’ Voice feature sparks genuine debate, exploring honest, unfiltered perspectives on prefect accountability and campus governance. Readers will also find post-exam reflections, lighthearted comics, detective brainteasers, and a discreet riddle slipped into the back pages. Read the complete publication, track campus event reports, and explore student editorial features online.
